desc:
Climb the tower by choosing between two doors every stage
Each choice changes your outfit… sometimes it helps, sometimes it ruins everything 🫢

Get different hairstyles, clothes, face accessories, neck accessories, and more to build your style 👗✨
Or get trolled with the worst combo possible 👕

Every run feels different with MILLIONS of outfit combinations to discover 🎲

Make it to the top and see how your final outfit turns out
Then compare your look with your friends and see who got the best style 😆

Like the game 👍 and join the Group for extra perks
